names: W05 follow-up: in the synthesis figure trace, a bare 'sales' (no modifier before it) names the Revenue row and a bare 'profit' the profit rows (EBITDA, EBIT, net income) less any the claim names itself, so 'while sales were $7,178M' (EBIT's figure) and 'profit was $60,372M' (revenue's) are refused; a qualified word ('comparable sales', 'open-market sales', 'segment profit') still names no row. On the 27 committed pages no flag moves
